description: Use when the user asks for the bull and bear case, who disagrees with a thesis, the counter-argument, or what would change a side’s mind. Returns, for one story by slug or part number, The DeepStack Call and its side, every attributed, paraphrased voice on each side with its date and source link, the strongest case against each side, where voices cross, and the dated tests that settle it.

part.description: The part number, as an alternative to the slug.

name: deepstack_sides
title: Who is on each side
